Context: Instructions for Pension Disbursing Authorities.-

## Instructions for Pension Disbursing Authorities.-  
- The pensioner is no longer required to visit bank in person for credit of his first pension. The undertaking with regard to recovery of overpayment from pensioner is forwarded to concerned bank CPPC through CPAO along with the PPO. Bank will not insist for the presence of pensioner in order to activate their pension account.
